features.title: Create and Innovate
features.description: Create or adapt open modules effortlessly, integrating multimedia like videos, podcasts, and data tools.

features.title: Collaborate and Adapt
features.description: Draft a pilot module with collaborators and solicit feedback with inline comments before publishing.

features.title: Teach and Share
features.description: Share modules as widely as you like for use in classroom, community, or remote learning settings

aboutOverview: Gala is working to make learning more grounded, dynamic, and collaborative by developing the open-source Gala platform and partnering with teams and networks to explore the possibilities of collaborative learning modules and case studies.
connect: We're eager to share your experiences creating and using modules on Gala with the rest of our community. We also invite contributions to the Gala guides and codebase, as well as module and UI translations. Contact our team at hello@learngala.com or via LinkedIn.
